title: build cannot read a store named outright, as a campaign member's is
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)

evidence.verified: TestBuildStore passes: `CS_BUILD_STORE` names the store outright, ahead of `CS_BUILDS_DIR` and the default. TestLocalModulesNamesAnotherStore passes too. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 3b3e213, once the nested sandbox smoke job was run again: its microVM had stopped answering.

resolution: `build` reads the store `CS_BUILD_STORE` names, as the other tools do, and `--local-modules DIR` names one for a single build.
details: `cs-sandbox build` reads the store of the owner it names its images after. A campaign member holds its store as a clone at a path of its own. The other tools will find that path through CS_BUILD_STORE (DSH-029), and `build` does not read it.
